verdict.rationale: Dagster's asset-based, code-first model and its dlt/Fivetran/Airbyte components let you represent loads to arbitrary destinations as assets without rewriting pipeline logic, which supports portability across targets in principle. However, the evidence pack contains no direct documentation of first-party Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, or object-storage I/O managers/resources, so the specific warehouse/lake portability claim is not directly substantiated. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Snowflake/BigQuery/Databricks/Postgres/object-storage I/O managers or resources, and evidence of swapping storage backends without code changes.
